column1: # Stock Kafka Streams baseline for the astubbs#255 PC-on-Streams module.
# GENERATED - do not hand-edit. Written by StockStatefulBaselineFixtureTest in
# parallel-consumer-example-streams, a module that does NOT depend on
# parallel-consumer-streams, so these rows come from the published kafka-streams jar
# and not from the module's patched target/classes. That independence is what makes this a
# baseline rather than a second copy of the thing under test.
# The stateful arm: a non-windowed count over a caching-disabled KV store. 'out' values
# are the running count for the key, rendered as a decimal string; the timestamp is the
# timestamp of the input record that produced that count.
# 'in' rows are the inputs in produce order, and the module-side test replays exactly these
# rather than rebuilding them, so the two arms cannot drift in what they were fed. Every
# input also carries a header named by probeHeader below, whose value is the record's own
# 'out' rows are the outputs in the order stock Streams emitted them.
